name: An Explosive Gambit
summary: You judge that breaking the Sin'dorei seals could trigger the crystals, giving you a chance to strike Magus Rimtori. Ag'tor Bloodfist in Valormok awaits proof of her death.

sections.title: A Calculated Strike
sections.body: The crystals' energies answer to the seals, and you see a way to turn that bond against Magus Rimtori. Breaking a seal could release its energy through the crystal in an explosive burst. The blast may catch Rimtori off guard, leaving an opening to attack her.

sections.title: At Valormok
sections.body: Ag'tor Bloodfist waits in Valormok for Magus Rimtori's head. He calls the blood elves traitors and says Rimtori deserves a painful death. When you return, he says Belgrom will be pleased and that dozens of warriors' spirits can finally be at peace.

faq.q: What am I supposed to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to break the Sin'dorei seals, then bring Magus Rimtori's head to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Valormok.
You reason that breaking a seal could release its energy through the crystal in an explosion.
Ag'tor Bloodfist asks you to bring him Magus Rimtori's head and says she deserves a painful death.

faq.q: Where do I bring Rimtori's head?
faq.answer: Bring Magus Rimtori's head to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Valormok.

faq.q: Why does Ag'tor mention the spirits?
faq.answer: Ag'tor says the spirits of dozens of warriors can finally be at peace.

attribution: In-game quest text: An Explosive Gambit
